scope: Batch 07G-2: original conditional, sourced champion field notes.

decisions.title: Switch between fighting modes with intent
decisions.text: Nightcrawler changes modes through specific combo endings and a dash-back block input. Confirm which mode is active before spending power, since the next Special and its available utility depend on the current state.

decisions.title: Build Swashbuckling Precision from eligible hits
decisions.text: Swashbuckling offers Precision opportunities through particular medium hits and timing interactions. Set up a safe combo opening and check the actual buff state rather than assuming the benefit is present immediately.

decisions.title: Choose Specials for the relevant damage effect
decisions.text: SP2 can support Bleed-focused pressure while a different Special route can convert existing Bleeds into Incinerate. Check defender protection and the active effect timer before deciding which sequence to use.

decisions.title: Build Momentum before entering Speed Burst
decisions.text: Northstar develops Momentum and Reverb-related resources through eligible attacks and Specials. Track the visible stacks and find a safe dash or recovery opening before expecting the Speed Burst result.

decisions.title: Spend the developed charge window deliberately
decisions.text: SP2 can convert accumulated resources into offensive value while SP1 can influence timing. Check the remaining duration and opponent power before launching, or the intended resource window may be lost.

decisions.title: Keep the SP3 upgrade for longer encounters
decisions.text: SP3 can improve subsequent Speed Burst triggering under the recorded rules, but it requires a sizeable power investment. A shorter fight may favor an earlier Special rather than a longer setup with little time to pay off.
